name: Mythos Card #0
description:
A complete set of Psychedelic Artworks + Psychedelic Music to enhance your Trippy vibes.
This BluePrint Project is designed and beautifully crafted while keeping all aspects of Psychedelic Art Style in Mind.

A unique combination of Psychedelic Mythos all designed under influence of Visionary and Cosmic Ideas that will make your soul astral project into different dimensions.

Being our first audio visual blueprint project , we guys crafted the art beautifully to mix with each other and produce acid trippy effects.
